chunks: Al-Sadiq عليه السلام was asked about the palm branch being placed in the grave.
So he said: "There is no issue."

key_terms.الصَّادِقُ: Imam Jaʿfar ibn Muḥammad al-Sadiq عليه السلام
key_terms.الْجَرِيدَةِ: the palm branch placed with the deceased
key_terms.لَا بَأْسَ: there is no harm or objection; it is permissible

ai.seo_question: Is it permissible to place a palm branch in the grave according to Imam al-Sadiq عليه السلام?
ai.summary: This hadith states that placing the palm branch in the grave is permissible. The reply of Imam al-Sadiq عليه السلام indicates that this practice carries no objection in ruling.

en.bab-ul-qaim-publications: Hadith.403 - Imam Jafar ibn Muhammad Al-Sadiq (as) was asked about placing the palm branch (jareedah) in the grave,
Imam (as) replied: "There is no issue (with it)”.
